candidates.title: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
candidates.finding: The RLE-Bench team describes 48 robotics-engineering tasks across interactive control, policy development, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. Agents work under task-specific time, interaction, and compute budgets, and solutions are independently evaluated under hidden physical conditions. The accompanying Harvard announcement emphasizes failures caused by mass, torque, geometry, payload and stability constraints rather than code quality alone.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Add a separate pre-deployment engineering-evaluation profile for HILO integrations: freeze task/resource budgets, keep development observations separate from hidden evaluation conditions, and include physical-constraint failure cases before any field study. These simulator/engineering results remain synthetic or preflight evidence and cannot contribute WANTED resident hours, retention, certification, or human keep decisions.
